title: Refactor remaining cognitive complexity violations across 25+ methods in 15+ files
description:
## Source
SonarQube static analysis audit (`Data/Pages/audits/ms-sonar-static-analysis-7-26-26.md`)

## Findings
~25 methods across 15+ files with cognitive complexity between 16 and 47 (limit is 15). These include:

**Razor Pages:**
- `Admin.razor` (L2076, 24), `Chat.razor` (L1350, 47), `MemoryViewer.razor` (L836, 30), `Pages.razor` (L1001, 18), `TrainingWorkbench.razor` (L674, 18)

**Hosting:**
- `GitHubOAuthCallbackHandler.cs` (L26, 29), `MemorySmithContentEndpoints.cs` (L17, 16), `MemorySmithPipelineSetup.cs` (L20, 25), `MemorySmithTelemetrySetup.cs` (L17, 26)

**Services:**
- `AdminSettingsService.cs` (L474, 31), `ChatContextPlanner.cs` (L19, 23), `ChatMarkdownRenderer.cs` (L308, 21), `MemoryGovernanceServices.cs` (L296, 35; L469, 20), `SemanticEmbeddingSearchService.cs` (L961, 20), `TagGovernanceService.cs` (L157, 36), `TaskDomainService.cs` (L439, 21), `TreeSitterChunkingService.cs` (L115, 19), `VarResolver.cs` (L60, 17; L226, 17), `WindowsServiceCommands.cs` (L54, 31)

**Storage, Bridge, Training:**
- `SqliteMemorySmithDatabase.cs` (L839, 21), `MemorySmith.Bridge/Program.cs` (L462, 23)
- `harness.py` (L80, L144, L249, L280, L341, L935)

## Impact
These methods reduce code maintainability, make testing difficult, and increase the likelihood of bugs during modifications.

## Action Required
Decompose each method: extract nested logic, reduce nesting depth, split by responsibility. Prioritize by complexity score (47 → 15 first).

## Effort
~4h

## Priority
P1 — Maintainability
